foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.intro: This is an internal verification page, not the homepage. It renders the brand tokens and the base components in both directions and both languages so they can be measured before the public site is built on top of them.

colorNotes.gold: Champagne gold (#B99B6C) measures 2.32:1 on warm ivory — decoration only, never text, and not even a focus ring.
colorNotes.goldDeep: The interactive gold (#7A5F38) is the approved colour for anything a person operates.
colorNotes.measured: Every ratio is measured by scripts/check-contrast.py, not estimated by eye.

foundation.typeSample: Arabic sample inside the same context
foundation.typeSampleLatin: Latin text in the same context

demo.fullNameHint: As it should appear on the invitation.

catalogue.title: Invitation designs
catalogue.intro: Each design is a starting point: wording, colours and type all remain adaptable.

editor.title: Your invitation
editor.pickSection: Choose a part of the invitation to edit it.

design.resetBody: Your words are kept. The colours, type, frame and layout go back to the original design, and you can undo this.

unconfigured.title: The catalogue is not connected yet
unconfigured.body: This deployment has no database configured, so there are no designs to show. Everything else in the build is real: the brand, the type system, the layout and the direction handling all render from the same code that will ship.
unconfigured.detail: One step remains: create the database project and set its URL and anon key as deployment variables. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.

invitation.title: Ready to send
invitation.label: The finished invitation
invitation.privateNote: This page is private to this browser. Nothing here is shared with anyone, and it is not indexed by search engines. Sending an invitation to guests is a separate step that has not been built yet.
invitation.nothingBody: Choose a design and start filling in your details; it will appear here.
invitation.brokenBody: Its design configuration could not be read, so it has not been drawn. Nothing has been changed or lost.

login.title: Operator console
login.intro: One operator only. No public sign-up, no customer accounts.
login.errorLocked: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
login.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts from this device. Try again later.

dashboard.title: Operator console
dashboard.senderNote: Used as the sender identity everywhere: message templates, the footer link, and wa.me links.
dashboard.sessionNote: The session is stored in the database as a hash, the cookie is httpOnly and SameSite=strict, and signing out revokes it immediately.
dashboard.nextStep: Next in the build: create an event, add its guests, and generate their links.

events.title: Events
events.intro: Create an event, then add its guests and their links.
events.savedReady: Saved, and everything is there — ready to send.

guests.title: Guests
guests.import: Paste a list, or an Excel/CSV export
guests.importHint: Copy the columns from your spreadsheet and paste them here (name, phone, category, companions, personal line). A header row is optional, in Arabic or English.
guests.rejected: Rows that could not be read
guests.none: No guests yet. Paste a list above.
guests.previewBanner: This is what the guest sees — it does not count as an open

totp.title: Verification code
totp.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
totp.lostDevice: Lost the device? There is no shortcut: use scripts/seed-admin.mjs --reset to recover the account, then enrol again. That is deliberate — any other shortcut becomes the way in.

settings.title: Settings
settings.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Changing it revokes every other session.
settings.passwordChanged: Changed. The other sessions were revoked.
settings.wrongPassword: The current password is not correct.

errors.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.

settings.totpHint: A 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy).
settings.enrolStep: Add this key to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows to confirm:
settings.enrolManual: Or enter it by hand in the app. There is no QR code yet.
